title: Composable Data Stack Structured Runtime Event
description: Provider-neutral shape for the high-value, long-retention events referenced in docs/observability.md. Raw/unstructured container logs are not required to match this schema; this schema only governs the structured tier (run status, record counts, failures, retries, health transitions).

service.description: Module instance id (spec.modules[].id) that emitted the event.

profile.description: metadata.name of the profile the emitting module instance belongs to.

environment.description: metadata.environment of the profile, matching cli/security.py's profile classification.

timestamp.description: Event time in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601, UTC recommended.

severity.description: Normalized severity, independent of any module-native log level naming.

correlationId.description: Optional identifier tying related events together across services (e.g. a run id or request id).

workloadId.description: Optional identifier for the specific job/run/asset/query the event describes.

resource.description: Optional name of the resource the event is about (table, asset, pipeline, endpoint, etc.).

recordCount.description: Optional count of records processed/affected, when applicable.

retryCount.description: Optional number of retries attempted for the described operation.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Must not contain secrets; see docs/observability.md redaction guidance.
